game.description: Punishing: Gray Raven is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic action RPG set in a world scoured by the Punishing, a machine virus that has forced humanity into hiding among the ruins of a high-tech Earth. You lead the Gray Raven squad of cyborg Constructs through stylish real-time combat built around signal-orb combos, QTE character switches, and demanding boss challenges, while a long-form sci-fi story unfolds chapter by chapter. It stands out for its sleek anime-mecha art direction, deeply customizable character kits, and a steady flow of story updates, limited events, and crossover collaborations.

currencies.name: Black Card

currencies.name: Event Construct R&D Ticket
currencies.note: Standard research ticket for event construct banners; the most common event mission reward.

currencies.name: Trade Voucher
currencies.note: Farmed shop currency exchanged for Inver-Shards and upgrade materials in the Voucher Exchange Shop.
